annotation_provenance: Model-assisted primary-source discovery; no human adjudication, raw-byte acquisition, QA generation, model evaluation or benchmark admission.
selection_log: Checked all five existing seed histories to avoid duplication.
Targeted primary-source discovery for plan revision, scope and explicit correction.
Selected Docker, Chrome, NASA, Sony and Lyft to widen publisher and relation coverage.
Recall and Stadia considered but not pursued into this register: additional mutable product pages would add less domain coverage within this bounded pass.

classification_policy.correction: Requires an explicit source statement that an earlier claim was wrong, or a documented replacement identifying erroneous earlier content.
classification_policy.plan_revision: A changed intent, target or policy is CHANGES, even if the publisher calls its decision wrong.
classification_policy.discovery_only: An inspected page is evidence for feasibility, not exact historical source availability or test admission.
classification_policy.bitemporality: Retain knowledge/availability time separately from event/target time and from correction effective scope.

grouping_and_leakage_rules: Split by complete history/program group, never by source, prefix, question or adjacent revision.
Co-locate reprints, translations, cached/live/archived versions, SEC exhibits and issuer pages.
Keep related Artemis missions together and all PlayStation device/region variants together to prevent neighboring facts leaking across splits.
Allocate future held-out groups before annotation/model selection; this discovery list is already visible to development agents and is not a blind test.

Strip contemporary navigation, recommendations and update banners from historical content only after independent version evidence identifies the correct body. Never silently backdate edited live text.
Freeze raw bytes, extraction recipe, SHA256 and availability evidence; refuse unresolved cutoff admission.
Record every eligible and rejected history during a fixed-time-window source enumeration, rather than retaining only sources where a method succeeds.

sampling_next_step.design: Predeclare publisher/time windows and enumerate all releases matching fixed lifecycle/change/correction terms; log inclusions and exclusions before running any model.
negative_controls: New actual outcomes that differ from prior plans
sampling_next_step.allocation: No train/dev/test assignment made in this discovery pass.
sampling_next_step.coverage_limit: Five convenience-selected English-language histories establish feasibility, not a representative sample or benchmark diversity claim.

histories.title: Docker Free Team sunset plan and reversal
histories.selection_basis: Phenomenon coverage and primary-source feasibility; no system outputs or QA labels consulted.
histories.classification_rationale: The issuer explicitly reverses its policy. Its earlier clarification of image deletion is not evidence of a retracted factual assertion. April 13 suspension and April 14 migration wording concern potentially different actions.

relation_time_schema.modality: announced_future for suspension; reported_actual for the decision to reverse, without assuming resulting operational state
relation_time_schema.precision_policy: Keep April 13, 2023 suspension and April 14, 2023 migration as separate scoped statements until adjudicated.

histories.title: Legacy PlayStation stores: reversal and later geographically scoped retirement proposal

histories.title: Lyft FY2024 forecast magnitude explicitly corrected from 500 to 50 basis points
histories.selection_basis: Phenomenon coverage and primary-source feasibility; no system outputs or QA labels consulted.
histories.classification_rationale: The issuer replacement identifies the precise earlier bullet as incorrect and explicitly gives its replacement. The SEC exhibit independently preserves the earlier wording. This corrects reporting of a forecast; it is not evidence of an actual realized margin or a newly changed outlook.

relation_time_schema.modality: forward-looking forecast in both documents; correction relation targets the earlier claim.
relation_time_schema.precision_policy: Preserve 500 and 50 in basis points, not percentages; FY2024 is the target period. Day-level dates cannot order same-day sources.
